main_question: Does variation in the dynamically expressed population-mean floral investment after generation20 alter unconditional survival, beyond what is attributable to inherited genotype states and unchanged Mendelian transmission?
scope: model-internal mechanistic experiment conditional on already observed model and budget choices; NOT full evolutionary-suicide test, not external islands
source_biology: canonical Model3 reproduce_kb and population.advance; no edits to biological source

design.visitor_initial: matched4 four synthetic optima 0.15/0.35/0.55/0.75, breadth 0.18; canonical independent visitor arrivals/loss from 64 seeds
design.source_allele_genotypes: 8 diploid three-locus joint genotype plants, standing variation SD=0.05 (v1 SD=0.10 failed genotype expression range), same founder master 61022981, matching mean .2, investment mean .35, assurance means .35/.65
design.post20_clamp: only for reproduction ledger, shift all parents' investment allele-based expression by constant target_mean_at_t20 - current_mean; allow the original unmodified DNA state to be used by population.advance for Mendelian inheritance; preserve within-generation investment deviations and allelic segregation variance; reject boundary [0,1] violations without clipping
design.boundary_feasibility: For fixed original genomic support [lo,hi] and any source mean/current mean in [lo,hi], an additive mean clamp is within [2*lo-hi, 2*hi-lo]; this envelope must lie in [0,1] BEFORE any visitor outcomes are run.
design.origin_v1_failure: Workflow 38015657188: dedicated source-only smoke passed, full new-history outcome runner stopped before completion with ValueError: mean-expression clamp exceeds trait range; none of v1 paths are treated as confirmatory. No clipping or selective deletion used.

outcomes.primary: all 64 independent visitor-history outcome pairs at N80>0, natural minus mean-expression-clamped
secondary: post20 unconditional N80 and first extinction time
among survivors final investment allele mean and inherited genotype variance conditional only
complete t20 state hash to ensure exact paired original source
outcomes.uncertainty: conservative paired exact Bonferroni Clopper-Pearson two exclusive discordance probabilities; alpha .05, effect ROPE +/-0.05 absolute probability points
outcomes.classification: resolved positive if CI lower >0.05, negative if CI upper < -0.05, practically equivalent if CI wholly within ±0.05, otherwise inconclusive
outcomes.inference_unit: independent stochastic visitor RNG history drawn from one Model3 generator, demographic replicates per history 1

controls: Sham-clamp mean target equal current mean must return original unchanged genomic and expressed state.
At t20 source alleles/IDs and all RNG stream states identical in both arms.
Do not redraw or overwrite underlying diploid genotype in inheritance.
Conditional trait means undefined after extinction, unconditional occupancy retains all histories.
Changing K keeps N0=8 and pollen background B=48; K influences cap over subsequent years but changes paths from the first recruitment.
Comparisons across assurance settings do not claim independent donor genotypes: shared founder RNG with shifted source assurance means.
Exact bound checks reject unsafe expression outside [0,1] instead of clipping.
claim_boundaries: Clamping the mean of expressed investment does NOT freeze allele frequencies, genetic drift or within-population trait variance.
The intervention changes genotype-phenotype mapping and can alter selective and demographic processes from generation20 onward; it does not isolate historical genetic drift.
A source-model genotype evolution-enabled versus true genetic-trait freeze comparison still requires another carefully specified operator.
No natural island inference, no genetic load or mutation accumulation, no population-level evolutionary suicide conclusion.

This is a revised engineering-feasible protocol AFTER v1 support failure; model source, trait window and visitor cohort are newly source-locked. Do not treat v1 partial histories as independent holdout successes.
